outcome.Summary: Fixed the INI parser in ini/ini.go to match the package's documented dialect. Changes: (1) trim the line first and recognize whitespace-indented `#`/`;` comments; (2) lower-case section names (keys were already lower-cased); (3) split on the first `=` instead of the last; (4) for quoted values, drop only the quotes and keep inner whitespace exactly instead of trimming; (5) only treat `;`/`#` preceded by whitespace (or at position 0) as an inline-comment start in unquoted values, via a new commentPos helper, so values like `http://x/?a=b` and quoted strings survive; (6) a repeated key now overwrites the earlier value. `go test ./...` exits 0.
